en.cmd.compare_files_desc: Show two files side by side, both editable, with their differences aligned and highlighted
en.cmd.compare_with_desc: Show the active file side by side with another file
en.cmd.next_desc: Jump to the next difference between the compared files
en.cmd.prev_desc: Jump to the previous difference between the compared files
en.cmd.switch_desc: Move the focus to the other file of the comparison
en.cmd.copy: Compare: Copy Change to Other Side
en.cmd.copy_desc: Make the other file's lines of the change under the cursor match this file
en.cmd.take: Compare: Take Change from Other Side
en.cmd.take_desc: Make this file's lines of the change under the cursor match the other file
en.status.not_comparing: Compare: no comparison is open here
en.status.no_change_here: Compare: the cursor is not on a difference
en.status.no_file: Compare: the active buffer is not a file
en.status.same_file: Compare: that is the same file twice
en.status.not_applied: Compare: %{name} was not changed — it is read-only, or it changed meanwhile
